dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's been thinking... You called yourself a "fish out of water," right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But since you're the Hydro Dragon, wouldn't "dragon out of water" suit you better?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Thank you for your suggestion. I will consider using the more accurate term in private occasions.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Please allow me to rephrase: As a dragon out of water...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pfft! That sounds kinda weird! Let's stick with the previous version instead.
